I believe this is just my lack of understanding with actionButton and isolate().

ui contains:

numericInput("number", "Number")
actionButton("clickhere", "click here")


server contains:

library(RMySQL)

conn <- dbConnect(<conn args>)

send_query <- reactive({
  
  input$clickhere
  
  isolate(dbSendQuery(conn, paste('SELECT * FROM table WHERE number =', number)))
  
})

... I just want the query to run when I click the 'click here' button.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: isolate problems
parts:
I think you need to put it in observe() instead of reactive(), or you
need to call send_query() from a reactive endpoint. If you have a
reactive expression that isn't used by any reactive endpoints, it
won't be called. You can test this by putting a print statement in
there.

A reactive endpoint is something that's in observe(). Additionally, if
you assign a reactive expression to an output, as in `output$foo <-
reactive( ... )`, it gets wrapped into an observe() under the hood.

This explained in more depth at
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#reactivity-overview

-Winston
